item.content:encoded: I really liked it and has planned to upvote until the last line (I am the last of the golems and I must escape.) Just something about 173 being something so simple and known as a golem threw me and I didn't like it. If it had said 'I am the last of my kind and I must escape' I would definitely upvote. But I like the idea of 173 being this unknown horror whose actions we can understand even though we can know nothing else. Novote for me.

Overall, its a good tale, and i like the idea of 173 not being as evil as its set up to be. that being said, part of the core idea of 173 is how it's so utterly alien and wrong to us, I feel its wrong to make it so empathetic.

no vote.
